name: speedtest
title: Speedtest
description: Run an internet speed test in the panel with the CLI you have (Speedtest by Ookla, speedtest-cli or fast) and watch it: a bar per direction with the live figure, ping and jitter, the server and the ISP. Nothing runs until Enter. The result is one line to copy; every run lands in a history with a trend drawn as bars.
author: pal

settings.label: Tool
settings.description: Which CLI runs the test. Auto takes Speedtest by Ookla (the only one that reports progress), else speedtest-cli, else fast. `speedtest` on PATH is told apart by its --version.

settings.label: Server id
settings.description: A speedtest.net server id to test against (`speedtest -L` lists nearby ones); empty picks the nearest. Ignored by fast.

settings.label: Runs to keep
settings.description: How many finished runs the history holds.

store.tagline: A speed test you can watch, in the panel
features: Runs the CLI you have: Speedtest by Ookla (with per-phase progress), speedtest-cli, or fast; the view says which, and names the brew formula and the npm package when none is installed
Never starts by itself: opening the palette shows the last result, Enter runs a test, Enter again stops it
Live: a bar per direction filling with the phase and the figure in Mbps beside it, the ping and jitter tiles, the server and the ISP, updated as the tool prints
One line to copy (`cmd+enter`): down, up, ping and jitter, the server, the ISP; `cmd+o` opens Ookla's result page
History (`cmd+h`): every finished run with its date, tool and server, and a Trend row drawing the last twenty as download and upload bars

screenshots.caption: Opened: the tool found; nothing runs until Enter
Downloading: the bar fills with Ookla's progress, the figure moves with it
Done: both figures, ping and jitter, the server and the ISP
The trend: the last runs as bars, download in blue and upload in green
Nothing installed: the three ways to get a tool

actions.title: Start the test
actions.description: Runs the tool; while it runs the same key stops it.

actions.title: Copy result
actions.description: Down, up, ping and jitter, the server and the ISP, on one line.

speedtest.description: The last result and the tool found; Enter runs a test and the view follows it live; Enter again stops it.

keys.title: Start the test (stop it while it runs)

history.description: Finished runs, newest first, with a Trend row that draws the last twenty as bars.

keys.title: Copy the run (on Trend: show the bars)
